text:
𝗡𝗘𝗧𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗦 𝗦𝗧𝗨𝗡 𝗣𝗔𝗞! 🇳🇱🇵🇰

Netherlands women chased 127 in 14.5 overs to win by 8 wickets at the Emerging Nations Trophy.
Pakistan (126/7) suffer their first loss of the event.

Upset or form? 👇

#WomensCricket #EmergingNationsTrophy

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗘𝗧𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗦 𝗡𝗘 𝗣𝗔𝗞𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗞𝗢 𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗔𝗬𝗔! 🇳🇱🔥

👉 Pakistan Women ne banaye 126/7
👉 Netherlands ne 127/2 banakar 14.5 over mein 8 wicket se jeet li
👉 Emerging Nations Trophy mein Pakistan ki pehli haar

Kya ye bada upset hai? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #WomensCricket #EmergingNationsTrophy
